Require --simulator in the actual config-only block and require fail-closed cleanup exit propagation.
Evaluated dynamic CocoaPods linkage in b7cd59d4; Run #9 reproduced the same Xcode 26.6 link failure, so the temporary change was reverted and the production Podfile remains canonical.
Require the simulator E2E workflow to pin all three jobs to macos-15 instead of the floating Xcode 26 macos-latest image.
Pin preflight, host FLOW5, and simulator matrix jobs to macos-15/Xcode 16 generation based on the Run #8/#9 Xcode 26.6 linker evidence.
Move RunnerTests to a top-level CocoaPods target with Flutter engine-only plus integration_test dependencies; keep Runner's full production pod installation unchanged.
Point only RunnerTests Debug/Release/Profile configurations at dedicated RunnerTests xcconfigs; Runner and PlanFlowWidgetExtension configuration references remain unchanged.
RunnerTests-only optional Pods-RunnerTests debug support include while preserving PlanFlow identity and Flutter generated settings.
RunnerTests-only optional Pods-RunnerTests release support include while preserving PlanFlow identity and Flutter generated settings.
RunnerTests-only optional Pods-RunnerTests profile support include while preserving PlanFlow identity and Flutter generated settings.
Enforce top-level RunnerTests, engine-only/integration_test pod scope, target-specific xcconfig wiring, shared Runner config protection, no-upload path, and existing XCTest host contract.
